original_value_policy: Public audit events contain SHA256 fingerprints and replacement text, never the original sensitive values.
rules: Known local source references become portable paths or source IDs.
Benchmark checkout root becomes <BENCHMARK_ROOT>; runtime installation root becomes <RUNTIME_ROOT>.
Explicit authentication credential metadata values, if present, become <REDACTED_CREDENTIAL>.
Any residual local home or private scratch path is replaced by a nonidentifying placeholder.
Saved design-workspace and source-archive root paths become <DESIGN_WORKSPACE_ROOT> and <SOURCE_ARCHIVE_ROOT>.
scientific_content_policy: Preserve complete task text, model outputs, queries, test examples, synthetic email addresses/passwords, private benchmark raw logs, actions, feedback and reflections. Only explicit infrastructure metadata and machine-specific root/reference paths are changed.
